Vestwell’s goalA strong foundation, with proof

Make the site technically ready so upcoming AEO content and PR work has impact, and show leadership a clear before and after.

Our scopeThe technical foundation

Page speed, HubSpot campaign pages, and SEO/AEO tags. No changes to tracking, design or content.

How we measure itGoogle PageSpeed Insights

The agreed primary metric. Baseline: average 50.5 on mobile across 494 pages. Target: 65+.
